title: Sterilizing world physics so others can't catch up

tellings.quote: One possibility is that one of the reasons we kicked all of the Americans out of our physics programs and science programs is that we wanted to sterilize the world so that it didn't catch up to us what we'd already done.

plain: The United States may have deliberately pushed people out of its physics and science programs so that the rest of the world could not catch up to what it had already achieved, according to the mathematician Eric Weinstein. He offers it as "one possibility", without a source. If true, it would mean physics was held back on purpose to protect a hidden lead.
